searchText: this is fixed now in Besu Re standardization of RPC error codes - is there any update on this PR https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/650 ? We are holding off on changing error codes in Besu until this PR is merged. This is still a work in progress, but I think we’re at the stage where we can actually reach finalization. During the last RPC call, <@809723543923064845> mentioned that he’ll be conducting more extensive testing of error codes across different clients, focusing on execution-based error cases and on feedback highlighted by <@628018527470616606> . We’d appreciate it if client teams could take a look at the proposal and share any feedback that might be helpful. Hey everyone 👋 We’ll be having our call today! There’s currently nothing on the agenda, so it’ll be an open session https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1758 <@194432762315407360> reminding about that eth_getLogs fuzzer <@628018527470616606> it's here: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/31613 we still need to merge that mostly we used it to check the results of the new log index I can just merge it now, one sec done the command is a part of the "workload" tool https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/tree/master/cmd/workload it's a tool that runs against a live mainnet or testnet node, which performs some RPCs as a regression test it can also be used to benchmark the log filtering btw, you pre-announced on ACDT that Nethermind will have a new log index? I think we should really talk about this more the thing is, we want to include the log index into consensus for several reasons. the first reason that got us here is being able to prove the results of log search. but for the future, we want to extend the index to auto-log eth transfers and also to have an in-consensus transaction hash index. these are very important steps for UX there are many RPC operations which are currently impossible to prove for the future, we want to get to a world where the execution node will provide a fully trustless API in order to make that useful, we need to prove: - log search results - tx hash lookup - account eth balance changes from incoming transfers ("internal transactions") can `eth_simulateV1` replace `eth_estimateGas` for applications? hm, i don't think it can. but it would be useful to have all of the same "override" capabilities for `eth_estimateGas` <@194432762315407360> qq about this test: eth_getTransactionReceipt/get-legacy-input Is there any reason why status shouldn't be return? We do return status for legacy txs, while geth doesn't? We have it in Geth, as an extension. Also there is an active proposal somewhere for a version of eth_simulate that does gas estimation The underlying receipt can either store the post-state `root` or the `status` but not both. It was changed in EIP-658 (Byzantium fork). When `root` is set, before byzantium, the `status` is meaningless, because it is not defined by consensus. that would be nice, do you know where i can find that proposal?

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: the thing is, we want to include the log index into consensus for several reasons. the first reason that got us here is being able to prove the results of log search. but for the future, we want to extend the index to auto-log eth transfers and also to have an in-consensus transaction hash index.

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: these are very important steps for UX

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: there are many RPC operations which are currently impossible to prove

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: for the future, we want to get to a world where the execution node will provide a fully trustless API

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content:
in order to make that useful, we need to prove:

- log search results
- tx hash lookup
- account eth balance changes from incoming transfers ("internal transactions")

excerpts.content: can `eth_simulateV1` replace `eth_estimateGas` for applications?

excerpts.author: frangio_
excerpts.content: hm, i don't think it can. but it would be useful to have all of the same "override" capabilities for `eth_estimateGas`

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
<@194432762315407360> qq about this test: eth_getTransactionReceipt/get-legacy-input

Is there any reason why status shouldn't be return? We do return status for legacy txs, while geth doesn't?

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: We have it in Geth, as an extension. Also there is an active proposal somewhere for a version of eth_simulate that does gas estimation

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: The underlying receipt can either store the post-state `root` or the `status` but not both. It was changed in EIP-658 (Byzantium fork). When `root` is set, before byzantium, the `status` is meaningless, because it is not defined by consensus.
